name: robots/wh200720041__warehouse_simulation_toolkit
title: Warehouse Simulation Toolkit (Gazebo, Pioneer 3DX)
intro: Warehouse Simulation Toolkit (Gazebo, Pioneer 3DX), adapted from wh200720041/warehouse_simulation_toolkit. It runs `publish_cmd_vel`. `publish_cmd_vel`: publish one geometry_msgs/Twist velocity setpoint on /cmd_vel for the Gazebo differential-drive subscription. The receipt is transmission evidence only, not motion, arrival or stopping. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
